messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

They havenâ€™t been faithful to his statutes, and havenâ€™t performed his works.","verse":24},{"chapter":7,"text":"Therefore, Esdras, for the empty are empty things, and for the full are the full things.","verse":25},{"chapter":7,"text":"For behold, the time will come, and it will be, when these signs of which I told you before will come to pass, that the bride will appear, even the city coming forth, and she will be seen who now is withdrawn from the earth.","verse":26},{"chapter":7,"text":"Whoever is delivered from the foretold evils will see my wonders.","verse":27},{"chapter":7,"text":"For my son Jesus will be revealed with those who are with him, and those who remain will rejoice four hundred years.","verse":28},{"chapter":7,"text":"After these years my son Christ will die, along with all of those who have the breath of life.","verse":29},{"chapter":7,"text":"Then the world will be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the first beginning, so that no human will remain.","verse":30}],"book_code":"2ES"}
